command_name.description: The skill or command whose text holds the shell command.

command_source.description: Where the skill or command came from; omitted when unknown. The vocabulary is undocumented.

level.description: Open string: the Agent SDK types it as string; the examples are the documented levels.

invoked_by.description: Who started the load. user: typed, or sent by an SDK host. claude: the Skill tool, or a turn that Claude scheduled. other: anything else, such as a subagent's preload or a channel message, or not known. Open string: an unrecognized value must be treated as other.

permission_mode.description: Open string: the Agent SDK types it as string; the examples are the documented modes.

scratchpad_dir.description: Session scratchpad directory; absent when the session has none or the temp directory is unavailable (Claude Code v2.1.257 or later).

command.description: The command as it would run, with arguments filled in.

tool_name.description: The shell tool that runs the command.

tool_use_id.description: Identifies this command; it names no tool call in the transcript.
